items.title: Freeze the strengthening roadmap parent intent
items.context: Capture the original intent for M4-M12: global roadmap governance, not one-off B-cd3a gap closure. The parent story must explicitly state that later child stories cover M4-M12 without scope shrinkage.
items.userSees: User sees a ProofStory original intent snapshot tying this story to the M4-M12 strengthening roadmap.

happy.desc: The story has an original intent snapshot that names lattice-strengthening-roadmap M4-M12 and says B-5082 gates are used to prevent roadmap scope shrinkage.

edge.desc: The snapshot distinguishes this roadmap parent ledger from B-cd3a, which covers global-control-plane and proof-admissibility gaps rather than the whole strengthening roadmap.

adversarial.desc: Reject any final claim that says all M4-M12 features are implemented by this parent story; this story only governs and slices the roadmap unless child evidence is attached.

verificationEvidence.note: ProofStory enforce gate passed with original intent snapshot, confirmed milestone ledger, parent rollup, slice plan, and no gaps; anchors roadmap parent intent to B-43de.
Roadmap relationship table explicitly separates B-43de parent ledger governance from B-cd3a control-plane/proof-admissibility gap closure.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "does not claim|does not implement M5-M12|Not runtime-complete in B-43de" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Roadmap text repeatedly states B-43de does not claim M5-M12 runtime implementation complete, so a parent DONE cannot be misread as all child milestones shipped.

items.title: Create the M4-M12 milestone ledger and slice plan
items.context: Use B-5082 milestone ledger and slice behavior to list M4 through M12, dependencies, expected child-story ownership, and verification commands. Oversized ledger must be cleared by slice plan rather than silently reducing milestones.
items.userSees: User sees M4-M12 as explicit ProofStory ledger rows with child-story ownership or planned slices.

happy.desc: The milestone ledger contains M4 through M12 with required evidence, checklist refs, and child-story or slice ownership semantics.

edge.desc: Because M4-M12 is oversized, a slice plan or parent roll-up must be present rather than letting the ledger shrink to fit the threshold.

adversarial.desc: Fail if a missing M7, M10, or M12 row can still allow a DONE-equivalent parent result without explicit shrinkage approval.

verificationEvidence.note: Roadmap document now has a B-43de parent governance section and explicit M4-M12 child-story-needed map; ProofStory gate also confirmed ledger, parent rollup, and slice-plan coverage.

ProofStory enforce report shows milestoneCount=9, thresholdState=too_broad, oversizedClearedBy=slice_plan, and missingParentRollup=[], proving oversized M4-M12 governance uses slice/rollup rather than shrinking.
Child-story status map keeps M7, M10, and M12 explicit as child-story-needed rows, so missing rows cannot silently disappear from parent governance.

items.title: Bind M4 process-fact registry closure as the first child implementation surface
items.context: M4 is the prerequisite for later gate facts. This item verifies existing process-fact registry coverage and records which M4 subwork is already covered by B-5082 and B-e1a8 versus which remains child work.
items.userSees: User sees which process-fact registry controls are already verified and which M4 rows still need child stories.

happy.desc: verify-process-fact-contract passes and explicitly covers ProofStory roadmap governance facts such as original_intent_snapshot, milestone_ledger, parent_ledger_rollup, and DONE intent equivalence.

edge.desc: The M4 status must not overclaim all process-fact work complete if later M5-M12 introduce new gate facts.

adversarial.desc: Fail if process-fact verification can pass while the roadmap no longer states M4 is a prerequisite for new gate-consumed facts.

verificationEvidence.note: Process fact contract verifier now checks roadmap governance markers and completed successfully with Process fact contract verified.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "M4 parent row|does not mark all future M4 runtime registry work complete" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: M4 section states B-43de governs the M4 parent row but does not mark all future M4 runtime registry work complete.

Process-fact verifier requires the roadmap markers for process-fact registry path, process-fact levels path, verifier command, and static verifier contract drift text, so the roadmap cannot drop M4 prerequisite markers unnoticed.

items.title: Publish final roadmap governance status and handoff table
items.context: Update the roadmap with a concise table showing S0 and M4 status, child-story mapping, and the next milestone order. The table must make unfinished M5-M12 visible rather than burying them in prose.
items.userSees: User sees a clear roadmap governance table: done, partial, child-story-needed, or future for M4-M12.

test: rg -n "ProofStory Governance Ledger|M4-M12 Child Story Map|M12" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md

happy.desc: The roadmap includes a visible ProofStory governance table with M4-M12 status and next child-story responsibilities.

edge.desc: The table preserves Tier-C experiment exceptions and active B-cd3a work as separate from global roadmap completion.

adversarial.desc: Fail if the table implies M5-M12 are done without child-story evidence or explicit future status.

verificationEvidence.note: Roadmap now includes visible governance/handoff status: B-43de parent governance, M5-M12 child-story-needed rows, and the existing roadmap preserves Tier-C duplicate experimental stories as a documented exception while targeting non-experiment duplicates for cleanup.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification|Duplicate cleanup applies to non-experiment|B-cd3a" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Roadmap now preserves Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories as an intentional experiment corpus, limits duplicate cleanup to non-experiment overlap, and keeps B-cd3a separate from global roadmap completion.

items.title: Verify ProofStory gates and roadmap contract before DONE
items.context: Run ProofStory gate, intent coverage, review completeness, DONE equivalence, process-fact contract, and routine validation so this parent story proves B-5082 governance rather than just describing it.
items.userSees: User sees ProofStory gate and DONE equivalence checks pass for the roadmap governance story.

happy.desc: All listed ProofStory and contract checks pass for the parent governance story before DONE.

edge.desc: If child stories are not complete, DONE equivalence may only pass by explicitly marking rows as parent-governed, future, or assigned, not by pretending implementation is done.

adversarial.desc: Fail if DONE equivalence ignores an uncovered milestone row or accepts prose-only evidence for a gate-consumed roadmap fact.
